anchors.observation: distinct subsystems sit inside dashed, labeled enclosures
anchors.decision: use dashed functional boundaries, not uniform filled cards

anchors.observation: orthogonal paths carry named commands, signals and power between regions
anchors.decision: draw routed, labeled power/data/control/heat paths with no unexplained diagonal shortcuts

anchors.observation: arrays, storage, antenna and thrusters have distinct technical glyphs
anchors.decision: draw editable solar grid, antenna, battery, wheel, radiator and nozzle symbols where they clarify function

anchors.observation: component nodes are nested in subsystem groups and external interfaces sit outside
anchors.decision: keep ground, Sun and space outside the spacecraft boundary

anchors.observation: connector labels identify data and command meanings
anchors.decision: label pathways and use color plus line style redundantly; crossing without a dot is non-connection

anchors.evidence: NASA 1974 Fig. 2-9 and NASA 2026 platform overview
anchors.observation: engineering diagram favors compact technical content over decorative surfaces
anchors.decision: reserve color for flow class and keep enclosure fills white
